python3 -c "
import trimesh, numpy as np, math
from manifold3d import Manifold, Mesh
w=trimesh.load('exports/model.wheel.675d7f4a.stl')
b=trimesh.load('exports/model.base.87e59dfb.stl')
def to_manifold(tm):
    v=np.asarray(tm.vertices, dtype=np.float64); f=np.asarray(tm.faces, dtype=np.int32)
    return Manifold(Mesh(vertProperties=v, triVerts=f))
bm=to_manifold(b); wm=to_manifold(w)
print('base vol', bm.volume(), bm.status(), 'wheel vol', wm.volume(), wm.status())
gap=37.3333333
def overlap(m):
    a=math.radians(-gap+m)
    wm2=wm.rotate([0,0,a]).translate([0,0,4])
    ov=bm ^ wm2
    return ov.volume(), ov.bounding_box
for m in [0,-10,-13,-17,-20,10,12,13,14]:
    v,bb=overlap(m)
    print(m, round(v,4), bb)
"
